name: PM Vishwakarma
hard_exclusions: specified similar government credit schemes within past 5 years
questions: What traditional trade do you work in?
Are you currently self-employed in that trade?
Have you taken a similar government business loan in the last five years?
temporal_note: Source says scheme initially implemented for five years up to 2027-28.

question.en: At registration, will you be working with your hands or tools in one of the scheme's 18 family-based traditional trades?
question.or: ପଞ୍ଜିକରଣ ସମୟରେ ଆପଣ ଯୋଜନାର ୧୮ଟି ପରିବାର-ଆଧାରିତ ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ବୃତ୍ତି ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଗୋଟିଏରେ ହାତ କିମ୍ବା ଉପକରଣରେ କାମ କରୁଥିବେ କି?

question.en: Do you work on a self-employed basis in the unorganized sector?
question.or: ଆପଣ ଅସଂଗଠିତ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ସ୍ୱନିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବେ କାମ କରନ୍ତି କି?

question.en: What is your age on the registration date?
Will you be the only member of your family registered under PM Vishwakarma?
question.or: PM Vishwakarma ଅଧୀନରେ ପଞ୍ଜିକୃତ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପରିବାରର ଏକମାତ୍ର ସଦସ୍ୟ ଆପଣ ହେବେ କି?

question.en: Are you in government service, or are you a family member of a government employee?
question.or: ଆପଣ ସରକାରୀ ଚାକିରିରେ ଅଛନ୍ତି କିମ୍ବା ସରକାରୀ କର୍ମଚାରୀଙ୍କ ପରିବାର ସଦସ୍ୟ କି?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: [EXCLUSION] specified similar government credit schemes within past 5 years

question.en: During the past five years, have you taken a loan under a similar government credit scheme listed by PM Vishwakarma?
question.or: ଗତ ପାଞ୍ଚ ବର୍ଷରେ ଆପଣ PM Vishwakarmaରେ ଉଲ୍ଲେଖିତ ସମାନ ସରକାରୀ ଋଣ ଯୋଜନାରୁ ଋଣ ନେଇଛନ୍ତି କି?
